title: Accounts with a positive balance
prompt: Return each account_id and the sum of its transaction amounts as balance, only for accounts whose balance is positive.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE transactions (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, account_id INTEGER, amount REAL); INSERT INTO transactions VALUES (1,1,100.0),(2,1,-30.0),(3,2,50.0),(4,2,50.0),(5,3,-10.0),(6,1,20.0),(7,3,5.0);
reference_sql: SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS balance FROM transactions GROUP BY account_id HAVING SUM(amount) > 0;
